Brown Sugar Blueberry Mojito
By: Forevernowandthen
Published: Thursday, April 21, 2011 - 9:35am

Ingredients




Ingredients
1 cup • Blueberry Puree (just put about 1 ½ cups of blueberries into a food processor 
1 • lime, juiced
10 • mint leafs
4 tablespoons • Brown Sugar
4 ounces • rum
• Club Soda (amount depends upon cup size)
• Ice

Preparation

1 Directions 2 Divide ingredients (mint, lime juice, brown sugar) evenly between two chilled glasses. 3 In the bottom of your glasses muddle (smash) the mint leafs, brown sugar and limejuice. 4 Add ½ cup blueberry puree and 2 oz rum to each glass. 5 Fill glasses with ice and club soda. 6 Enjoy.
